agentCost.method: bench/scripts/agent-cost.py — opencode session ledger (tokens/cost, attributed by card id in the session title) + committed kanban/lead-log evidence (merged PRs, REQUEST-CHANGES verdicts, sync rounds, infra deaths).
honestLimits: tokens measure agent output, not human wall-clock; cost 0.00 on the free tier makes tokens the only comparable unit
sessions without a card id in the title are reported as `unattributed` — project-wide cost, not one track's
the ledger is a lower bound: it only holds sessions this machine still has (see sessions.coverage)
lead-log counts are regex over prose; the log is the evidence, the numbers are an index into it
